check_obstacle_vision_lidar: check if an obstacle is in front of a robot using vision point cloud and optional lidar scan
detect_lidar_obstacle: detect if a lidar scan has points within a bounding box in front of the robot
segment_ground_plane: segment the ground plane from a point cloud scan using RANSAC and return non-ground points
crop_points_in_front: crop a point cloud to only include points in front of the robot within a distance range
create_o3d_pointcloud: create an Open3D point cloud object from numpy arrays of points and RGB colors
